_comment: ATS watchlist, polled by watch.mjs. EVERY entry must have been VERIFIED against the API and its hosted page (node probe.mjs "Company Name"). Never guess a slug: a wrong one is indistinguishable from a company with no openings. Entry shape: {"name": "Acme", "ats": "ashby|greenhouse|lever|smartrecruiters|teamtailor|workable|recruitee|personio|workday", "slug": "acme", "domain": "careers.acme.com (Teamtailor custom domain only)", "site": "External (Workday only)", "host": "wd3 (Workday only)", "note": "why it is watched"}. `name` must be the REAL company name, spelled as in the tracker: the poller cross-checks applications/applications.csv at runtime to enforce one application per company. `applied: true` is only for applications that predate the tracker. SmartRecruiters slugs are CASE SENSITIVE.

_collisions_do_not_add._note: Slugs that answer but belong to a DIFFERENT company than the name suggests, or boards that are dead although their API still answers. Key = slug or ats/slug. Discovery never re-adds them.
_collisions_do_not_add.ashby/neon: a games payments platform, not Neon Postgres

_no_api_check_by_hand._note: Targets with no queryable board (Avature, SuccessFactors, Taleo, iCIMS, bespoke career sites, mail only). They stay manual, each with a cadence and a TRIGGER written as an observable event ("first full-time software req in <city>"), not as a vague wish.
